_comment: Cooking at inns (docs/draft/food-system.md §4–§5). Every innkeeper (an NPC who rents rooms) offers "Order a hot meal" (pay, eat it on the spot: its hours of fullness and its buff) and "Cook my food" (cook_cost gold per raw food you carry, no wait; innkeepers don't salt). Meal buffs are one at a time: a new meal's effect replaces any in meal_effects. Cooking in the wild (a tinderbox fire, 30 minutes) and salting are item data: a raw food's "cook" and "salt".
